scripts.dev:backend: npm run setup:gmrepo -- --auto && npm run prepare:runtime && cd backend && node ../scripts/backend-python.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.migrate: cd backend && node ../scripts/backend-python.mjs -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.openapi: cd backend && node ../scripts/backend-python.mjs -m app.cli.export_openapi && npm --prefix ../frontend run openapi:types
scripts.test:coverage: cd backend && node ../scripts/backend-python.mjs -m pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=70 && npm --prefix ../frontend run test:coverage
scripts.audit: npm run audit:python && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
scripts.check:openapi: cd backend && node ../scripts/backend-python.mjs -m app.cli.export_openapi --check && npm --prefix ../frontend run openapi:types:check
scripts.lint: cd backend && node ../scripts/backend-python.mjs -m ruff check app tests && npm --prefix ../frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && node ../scripts/backend-python.mjs -m mypy app && npm --prefix ../frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:coverage && npm run check:openapi && npm run audit && npm run test:e2e
